prompt: What is the name of the in-place, stable comparison sorting algorithm with a worst-case time complexity of O(n log n) and a best-case time complexity of O(n)?
answer:
The algorithm is **WikiSort**—a stable, adaptive, in-place merge sort.

Its typical guarantees are:

- **Stable**
- **Worst case:** \(O(n \log n)\)
- **Best case:** \(O(n)\)
- **Auxiliary space:** \(O(1)\)

It is also sometimes described as a **stable in-place block merge sort**.
